definitions.gloss: to corner; to drive into a corner; to push to the brink
definitions.explanation: To chase or pressure someone until they have no escape or options left. Used both literally (physically cornering) and figuratively (emotionally or psychologically pushing someone to their limit).

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}を{追|お}い{詰|つ}めた。
{借金|しゃっきん}に{追|お}い{詰|つ}められて{苦|くる}しんでいる。
examples.english: I'm suffering, driven into a corner by debt.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}を{追|お}い{詰|つ}めすぎると、{心|こころ}も{体|からだ}も{壊|こわ}れてしまう。
examples.english: If you push yourself too hard, both your mind and body will break down.

notes:
{追|お}い{詰|つ}める is a transitive ichidan verb formed from {追|お}う (to chase) + {詰|つ}める (to pack in, to close in).

ASPECT (ている):
{追|お}い{詰|つ}めている describes the ongoing process of cornering someone. {追|お}い{詰|つ}められている describes being in a cornered state.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Aを{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (corner A)
- Aに{追|お}い{詰|つ}められる (be cornered by A)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {犯人|はんにん}を{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (corner a criminal)
- {精神的|せいしんてき}に{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (push someone psychologically)
- {自分|じぶん}を{追|お}い{詰|つ}める (push oneself too hard)
- {追|お}い{詰|つ}められた{状況|じょうきょう} (a cornered situation)

The passive form {追|お}い{詰|つ}められる is very common, describing the experience of being under extreme pressure.
